text.p: Severe flooding is ongoing in the US North Plains, especially along the Red River near Fargo, North Dakota. Recent heavy snow, then warmth and melting, started the flooding. A current cold snap has frozen some of the flood waters and now ice jams on rivers are adding to flooding problems.

Tropical Storm Ida (02W) is near 9n/157e, moving west-northwest at 5 mph. Top winds are near 70 mph. Ida continues to intensify and should be at typhoon intensity over the next few hours. This system will become and increasing risk to shipping with top winds near 120 mph by 48 hours. Ida may threaten the Northern Mariana Islands by 72 hours or just beyond.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
